verdict.rationale: Gunderson Dettmer offers client-facing data platforms (GDHQ, Contract Generator, D&O Portal, Catalyze), so data-residency choice is a fair question to ask. Nothing in the evidence shows users can pick a storage region. The ChatGD mention of an enterprise OpenAI instance on Microsoft Azure is an internal attorney tool and a host-platform detail, not a user-selectable residency control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
